title: Aachen surrenders
body:
The last German defenders in Aachen surrendered after weeks of fighting. It was the first city on German soil captured by the Allies.

The U.S. 1st and 30th Infantry Divisions encircled it, then fought through the ruins street by street.
photoNote: German prisoners taken at the fall of Aachen marching through the ruined streets, October 1944. NARA 541597, public domain.
